single_model_candidate.concern: Adopting a new generative model solely to supply frozen constants relocates rather than resolves the evidence burden.

A_R5_02_INDICATOR_FINITE_MEMORY.candidate_route: Explicit contracting Markov/stochastic-recursion model plus uniform indicator coupling/contraction proof and parameter uncertainty control.

A_R5_03_LOCAL_MARGINAL_APPROXIMATION.dependency: Must use the same explicit process model as A_R5_01/A_R5_02.

A_R5_04_TIME_SMOOTHNESS.concern: Global uniform second-time-derivative bound is not supplied by reviewed Treasury evidence; regime-shift evidence makes casual acceptance unsafe.

A_R5_05_UNIFORM_MOMENT.dependency: Requires an explicit innovation/tail model and stability bound from the same adopted process model.

redesign_principles: Prefer assumptions tied to observable or auditable quantities.
Reduce population constants that cannot be independently bounded.
Retain prospective CandidateDomain semantics where supportable.
Reassess all-later/latest-state requirements under candidate replacement methods.
Evaluate bounded/robust transforms that reduce moment assumptions.
Separate descriptive stability evidence from probability guarantees.
Do not hide a strong generative model beneath a nominally nonparametric method.
